Subject: Urgent: Complaint regarding recent billing on account #48812

Hello, I'm writing to urgently flag a problem with my latest invoice from Northwind Utilities. I was charged twice for the same service period, and the administrator I spoke with on the phone couldn't explain why. I've attached screenshots of both charges and the confirmation email I received. Please review these instructions for filing a formal complaint and confirm the refund timeline. If this isn't resolved within five business days, I'll need to escalate it to my bank.

intent.requested_action: review the complaint and confirm the refund timeline

items.text:
Subject: Feedback on your draft and a note about the AI writing assistant

Hi Elena,

I wanted to share some comments on your research paper draft, "Adaptive Methods for Low-Resource Language Processing." Overall, the argument is compelling and the literature review is thorough. However, the methodology section could benefit from a clearer explanation of how you handled the annotation process. Also, the administrator of the dataset you used has requested that you include a specific citation for the corpus, which is mentioned in their instructions online. Please add that before the next revision.

On a separate note, I noticed you used an AI writing assistant to help with the abstract. While that's fine for grammar, be sure to review the content for accuracy and originality. The university's policy requires disclosure of such tools, so you might want to add a brief acknowledgment.

Lastly, I had trouble accessing the supplementary files because my password for the shared drive expired. Could you re-share them with the updated link? Let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Dr. Samuel Park

intent.requested_action: add citation, review AI-assisted content, and re-share supplementary files
